info.title: OpenHall API
info.description: Self-hosted school presence and movement platform API.

operatorCredential.name: Authorization
operatorCredential.description: One-time operator credential: `Bootstrap <token>` on bootstrap prepare, `Recovery <token>` on recovery consume. Never sent in query or cookies.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable or not current.

get.description: Returns the current session. Anonymous callers receive authenticated:false. Authenticated callers receive a stable per-session CSRF token derived from the session credential; reading never mutates authentication state.
Minimal canonical identity for the authenticated person (self-only).
Public login metadata. Returns tenant/provider display info for a single-tenant installation or a known slug; otherwise requires tenant selection without enumerating slugs.
Starts an OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE (S256) login. Responds 302 to the provider authorization URL. Status documented: 302 success; 400/502 problem on failure.

302.description: Redirect to the provider authorization URL

schema.description: Redirect to the provider authorization URL

get.description: OIDC callback. Always responds 302: success redirects to the safe local return path with a fresh HttpOnly session cookie; failure redirects to /?error=<code> with a safe machine-readable code. OIDC protections (state/browser binding/nonce/PKCE/replay) apply instead of the SPA CSRF header.

302.description: Redirect to the return path (success) or /?error=<code> (failure)

Set-Cookie.description: Fresh session cookie on success (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax)

schema.description: Redirect to the return path (success) or /?error=<code> (failure)

post.description: Revokes the current session. Requires the session cookie, the X-CSRF-Token header, and a same-origin request.
Revokes every session for the account by bumping session_revision. Requires the session cookie, the X-CSRF-Token header, and a same-origin request.
Consumes a one-time recovery grant from the Authorization header (never query) and creates a short-lived recovery session.

get.description: Reports whether initialization is required. Reveals nothing about active bootstrap tokens.

post.description: Validates tenant/school/admin details plus the OIDC provider (live discovery), stores the encrypted draft, and starts the bootstrap OIDC flow. The operator credential travels in the Authorization header, never query or ambient cookies.

400.description: Invalid setup details or provider configuration

get.description: Schools the authenticated person may legitimately enter right now. Recovery sessions are rejected.
What the authenticated person may do in one exact school, plus their own schedule context. Unknown or inaccessible schools return 404 without revealing existence.

post.description: Request a pass for the authenticated student. The target student and request source are server-derived. Requires Idempotency-Key (OpenHall API contract, not a finalized IETF RFC). Success returns ETag for the pass revision. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed destination, student, or pass resource

409.description: Active pass exists, key reused, invalid transition, or destination unavailable

post.description: Staff-created pass request for a student. Organization-level pass.create.student is attempted first; denied teachers fall back to the resolved current section. Requires Idempotency-Key (OpenHall API contract). Success returns ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed destination, student, or pass resource

409.description: Active pass exists, key reused, invalid transition, or destination unavailable

get.description: Read the authenticated student’s current active pass, or pass:null. Cookie-authenticated; not CSRF-protected. Success returns ETag when a pass exists. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.description: Self-cancel an own student_web pass in requested/queued/ready. Requires Idempotency-Key and the exact strong ETag in If-Match; missing If-Match is 428, stale is 412. Idempotent replay returns the stored success. Success returns the new ETag. Cache-Control: no-store.

400.description: Malformed input or invalid idempotency key

404.description: Concealed destination, student, or pass resource

409.description: Active pass exists, key reused, invalid transition, or destination unavailable
